minor_findings.summary: Unicode typography is normalized in metadata
minor_findings.evidence: The original title uses em dashes and the yield uses a full-width ６, while the candidate uses en dashes and an ASCII 6. The numerical and linguistic meaning is unchanged.

rationale: The multilingual ingredient text, two setup dependencies, full four-operation flow, timings, temperatures, completion criteria, and final output are preserved. Only non-semantic typography differs in title and yield metadata.
